name: Hildreth
found: Shrine of Thulda, spinning wool by the door.
sayings: The dead are in no hurry. Neither am I.
wants: Proper funeral rites, peace for the dying.
dreams: A successor, and to die in her sleep at the shrine.
family: Outlived her husband and two children.
tragedies: Buried her husband and both her children at her own shrine.
